stem: \[x + y = 10\] \[ax + 3y = 18\] In the system of equations above, \(a\) is a constant. The solution \((x, y)\) to the system satisfies \(x = 2y\). What is the value of \(a\)?
solution: Substitute \(x = 2y\) into the first equation: \(3y = 10\), so \(y = \frac{10}{3}\) and \(x = \frac{20}{3}\).
Substitute into the second equation: \(a \cdot \frac{20}{3} + 3 \cdot \frac{10}{3} = 18\), so \(\frac{20}{3}a = 8\).
verify:
a, x, y = symbols('a x y')
xy0 = solve([x + y - 10, x - 2*y], [x, y])
assert xy0 == {x: Rational(20, 3), y: Rational(10, 3)}
sol = solve(Eq(a*xy0[x] + 3*xy0[y], 18), a)
assert sol == [Rational(6, 5)]
assert [Rational(v) for v in spr_answers] == sol
